title: Beevil Knievel: Precision Apiculture Cyber-Physical Monitoring and Honeybee Acoustic Leakage Benchmark
description: Complete research artifacts, reproducible evaluation pipelines, and telemetry datasets for honeybee (Apis mellifera) bioacoustic classification and edge-native colony monitoring. Includes pre-registered evaluation protocols separating split leakage from acoustic feature encoding across 1,836,914 telemetry rows and 53 hives from the public MSPB dataset.
